marker.appname: basename of the config dir (nvim by default)
marker.written_by: install.sh, after a clean headless plugin bootstrap
marker.meaning: plugins installed; absence does not mean the editor is absent

legacy_marker.written_by: install.lua in v0.3.1 and earlier; no longer written

states.installed: config dir holds both identity_files and surface_file; read interface and version from the surface file
states.installed_without_surface: config dir holds both identity_files but no surface_file: a release older than v0.4.0; interface unknown, treat as not compatible
states.existing_config: config dir is non-empty and lacks either identity file: a foreign config; never overwrite without consent

container.note: images and CI: non-root, no terminal; --nvim installs the official Neovim tarball (sha256-verified); --strict fails on a failed or incomplete plugin install; the image provides git, curl, Lua, a C compiler, Node.js and pnpm

install.skip_packages_note: set to 1 when the image already carries git, curl, Lua and the editor dependencies: install.sh and install.lua install no system package, and a missing tool stops the run

script.mirror_note: the website's copy; from v0.4.1 it is byte-identical to the release's install.sh — use it only when its sha256 equals script.sha256, otherwise use url
script.sha256_file: install.sh.sha256 (next to install.sh on the website and on the release)

steps: download script.url (or mirror_url, or release_asset_url) to a local file named install.sh
verify its sha256 equals script.sha256; stop on mismatch
run it: bash install.sh (it installs its own release, v0.5.0; DWP_VIM_REF overrides it)

consent.existing_config: an interactive run asks before moving it aside; a run without a terminal aborts with instructions and leaves the existing config untouched (missing prerequisites such as git, curl or Lua may already have been installed by the preflight)

features.summary: Every mapping in the config, generated live from the actual keymaps, grouped and searchable.
Select all in normal mode; yank to the system clipboard in normal and visual mode.
Sidebar of every Deep Work Plan grouped by status with progress; Enter opens a plain-language reader; a clickable statusline segment and a dashboard overview show the active plans.
Preview markdown in the browser or render it in the buffer.
install.sh: preflight, clone, system setup and headless plugin install; consent-first for an existing config.
